groups: route: actual paired handoff, device/client identity, exact lease address and producer exclusion
route: released/failed producer attempts retain current-boot history and cannot reuse EFI-off evidence
route: actual early entry permanently records possible hardware use before late route publication
route: real kernel next_arg handles quoted early/console aliases and -- without inventing an argument parser
route: ACPI/stdout, live debug node, wrong physical controller and invalid firmware evidence never publish ownership
route: fresh evidence errors fence the actual generation and preserve the error without self-join
route: PM retires and joins but keeps producer exclusion; no unproved resume-time evidence rearm
route: failed remove retains real publication/context; later joined end/unregister releases exclusion without clearing the error
route: actual callback pin survives unregister inside cancel_join through final callback return
route: real concurrent retirement waiters keep completion storage and producer fence alive through the original callback
route: real worker join completes before a functional EUD producer can be granted after removal
route: active owner excludes late EUD early entry; wrong overlapping base rejects and unrelated hardware remains separate
route: PM1 two real suspend/resume generations keep exclusion and permit new exact leases without reboot
route: PM2 nonzero live CSR after sleep permanently blocks without route writes or owner resume
route: PM3 a second CSR read changing from zero refuses a false stable-off result
route: PM4 invalid post-sleep EFI receipt remains fenced even with live CSR zero
route: PM5 a failed pause is permanent and is not retried by prepare or complete
route: PM6 a callback retaining an active lease cannot be accepted as joined
route: PM7 callback reference survives unregister inside pause and no stale resume is dispatched
route: PM8 real removal while paused retires permanently and releases mapping before debug exclusion
route: PM9 an existing resource owner prevents mapping or MMIO reads
route: PM10 mapping failure releases the claimed region before admitting another producer
route: PM11 real concurrent duplicate prepare/early complete cannot bypass the original in-progress join
